extracted.name: Chicken Salad with Grapes
extracted.description: This chicken salad with grapes is a quick, easy, and delicious filling for croissants or any bread. A simple treat for outdoor picnics or summer lunch!
ingredient_lines: 2 (12 ounce) cans chicken breast chunks, drained
instruction_lines: Break chicken breast chunks into small pieces in a large bowl. Mix in grapes, celery, and onion. Season with dill, salt, and pepper.

Whisk together mayonnaise, sugar, and vinegar in a small bowl until sugar dissolves. Pour dressing over chicken mixture; mix until well combined. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes before spreading salad onto croissants to make sandwiches.
